summary: M7 checkpoint, part 2. You add POST /api/assist to the .NET gateway, with the role header and a mapping of 422 to 400, then build a React and TypeScript chat page with Vite that shows the answer and the tool calls. A person can now use the tool through a page, with clear messages when something fails.
goal: M7 checkpoint: one question uses the tool through the page.

items.text: Add /api/assist to the gateway and see 10 tests pass
Create the Vite page and add the proxy to vite.config.ts
Write api.ts with the types and ApiError
Write App.tsx with the messages, the role selector and the tool calls
Run npx tsc -b and npx vite build
Try the page as a customer, as staff and with Python stopped, and press Enter too
Add the README section, then commit and push
